ITEM 1 | Thin white onion slices, pale translucent white with faint purple edges, separated into loose curved rings and strips about 0.3 cm wide and 4-6 cm long, moist and glossy, mounded in the center of a stainless steel bowl | 60
ITEM 2 | Shredded orange carrot, bright orange matchstick strips about 0.2 cm thick and 4-6 cm long, slightly moist with a fine stringy texture, scattered over and among the onion, mainly in the center and right side | 30
ITEM 3 | Diced red bell pepper pieces, glossy red chunks about 1 cm across, few visible, scattered near the top center of the pile | 6
ITEM 4 | Diced green bell pepper pieces, bright green pieces about 1 cm across with pale inner edges, few visible, scattered among the carrot and onion | 5
ITEM 5 | Small purple-red onion pieces, dark magenta fragments partly hidden under the white onion slices in the lower center | 8
